notes:
Inbound from YC-backed neobank-ish startup. Founder (CTO: Priya Mehta) signed up for free credits and poked around API docs. Wants to prototype statement-summarization chat + fast embedding search over transaction history. Very cost-sensitive — asked about per-token pricing and caching strategies. Early security asks: SOC2 checklist, SSO (SAML) compatibility, audit logs, short data retention for PII; prefers US-only data residency for now. VPC-curious: would consider Dedicated/VPC after product-market fit but wants hosted to move fast.

Call highlights (03/04): 
- "We need something we can wire into Plaid and have an assistant summarize transactions in user-facing chat. Latency p50 target ~150ms for short responses, can tolerate p95 up to 700ms for long summaries."
- Interested in embeddings for semantic search of transactions and merchant lookups.
- Asked if Redwood supports token-level cost breakdown (yes) and whether batching/autocaching suggestions exist (discussed Redwood Optimize briefly).

Technical concerns from SE convo:
- SAML SSO: they use Okta; want hosted API auth flow for team users + audit logs.
- Data residency: US-only for now (legal + bank partners).
- SOC2: asked for our auditor report/sample controls — needs to send to legal.
- Model preference: leaning open models (Llama-style) to control costs, but wants Redwood-verified perf numbers before committing.

Notes/behavior: "very hands-on devs, timeline is 6-8 weeks to production POC if infra and cost look OK." POC milestones: 1) basic chat prototype with hosted API keys (dev), 2) embeddings pipeline for transaction search (staging), 3) cost/latency report and brief eval vs small open infra.

AE/Jordan: pricing intro done. Offered short trial + $1k credits to run POC. SE Aanya to run technical Q&A and prepare SOC2 summary + SSO flow doc.

Quick wins to push forward: send security FAQ + SOC2 excerpt, attach step-by-step hosted API quickstart for Plaid ingestion, include recommended batching/cache config for transaction workloads.
